verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26670171 from Karton Nowak to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318793 (dated 2026-11-17). One item: 00010 CMP-GAM-004 Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6 (USK/PEGI), 210,000 pcs at 0.06 EUR, confirmed for 2026-12-14. Terms are DAP Hamburg and NET30. The supplier states it will print to artwork rev. C, received from Soony Marketing on 2026-08-07.
red_flags: Supplier confirms printing to artwork rev. C (received 2026-08-07); the buyer should check that rev. C is the current approved artwork for CMP-GAM-004.
observations: Typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The document has no issue date; 2026-11-17 is the date of the buyer's order.
The quantity has no unit stated, and the quantity uses a comma as thousands separator (English convention) so 210,000 read as 210000.
